{
  "$schema": "https://json.schemastore.org/claude-code-plugin-manifest.json",
  "name": "devflow",
  "displayName": "DevFlow Skills Collection",
  "version": "2.1.0",
  "description": "A verification-first development pipeline for Claude Code: brainstorm to plan to phased implementation, with quality gates (verification-loop, code-review, security-review), adversarial review, TaskTracker-native variants, and a HUD that shows a phase's progress and guards the orchestrator.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Martin Hylleberg",
    "url": "https://github.com/mhylle"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/mhylle/claude-skills-collection#readme",
  "repository": "https://github.com/mhylle/claude-skills-collection",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "workflow",
    "planning",
    "brainstorming",
    "code-review",
    "tdd",
    "quality-gates",
    "tasktracker"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "projectId": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "TaskTracker project id",
      "description": "Used by the HUD to find the requirements linked to the active phase. Learned from TaskTracker calls when left empty.",
      "default": ""
    },
    "orchestratorSkills": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Orchestrator skills (regex)",
      "description": "A main-thread Skill call matching this turns the HUD's orchestrator guard on.",
      "default": "implement-plan|implement-phase|tt-workflow-run"
    }
  }
}
